verdict.rationale: SSO/SAML for organization access is a fair security question for a SaaS work-management platform like ClickUp, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions SAML, SSO, or identity-provider integration. The only sign-in-related items ("Let people sign into their ClickUp account" and the OAuth2 flow for third-party apps) describe developer-app authentication, not organization-level SSO.
